description: A-share strategy implementation based on the logic of following insider buying (simulated via technical proxy due to data constraints). It uses A-share specific models (Fee, Settlement, BuyingPower) and implements direct OnData logic for entry, fixed holding period exit, and risk controls (trailing stop, max drawdown).
risk_controls: Trailing Stop: 10% drop from highest price since entry
Max Drawdown: 20% drop from entry price
Time-based Exit: Liquidate after fixed holding period (180 days)
